name: Gas Giant
desc: Close orbit over a gas giant's cloud tops, deep enough in that the atmosphere is the whole sky — alternating zonal jets locked to latitude, shearing violently past each other at every margin, tearing the cream cloud sheet open onto the rust deck below while ammonia cirrus streams over the top and long-lived ovals spiral everything they drift under; as a jovian cloudscape, a cold ice-giant, false-color thermal, sumi ink bands, or spectral.

energy.doc: jet strength — how fast the bands stream, how hard the ovals spiral, and the contrast between belt and zone (the master knob)

scale.doc: band width — from a finely ruled atmosphere of many thin jets to a few vast lazy ribbons

speed.doc: rotation and evolution rate (0.2 still turns)

density.doc: COUNT of storm ovals riding the jets (the first is always the Great Oval)

haze.doc: high ammonia cirrus — from clear sharp cloud tops to a thick milky veil drowning the bands

hue.doc: hue of the bright zones (belts and the deep deck take related shades)

y.doc: latitude — pan from the banded equator toward the polar chaos

style.doc: aesthetic: rust-and-cream jovian cloudscape / cold blue ice-giant with sparse cirrus / false-color thermal / sumi ink bands on paper / spectral false-color

seed.doc: deterministic seed for the jet phases, cloud texture and oval placement
